Topics.Title: Foreign nation or people group
Topics.Question: Does the verse mention a named non-Israelite nation, people, or ethnic group (e.g., Egypt, Canaan, Philistia, Moab, Assyria, Babylon)?

Topics.Title: Hostile or enemy foreigner
Topics.Question: Does this verse itself present a non-Israelite or foreign group as an enemy, a threat, or a party in conflict?

Topics.Title: Friendly or allied interaction
Topics.Question: Does the verse show a positive or cooperative relationship with a non-Israelite (alliance, help, hospitality, trade, or mutual recognition)?

Topics.Title: Blessing or promise involving the nations
Topics.Question: Does this verse itself contain a promise or blessing from God that includes non-Israelite nations or peoples, or says that they will be blessed? A human offer, agreement, marriage proposal, or wish is No.

Topics.Title: Judgment against a foreign nation
Topics.Question: Does the verse announce or describe divine judgment, curse, or destruction directed at a non-Israelite nation or people?

Topics.Title: Legal instruction concerning foreigners
Topics.Question: Does the verse give a command, law, or instruction that specifically addresses how Israel is to treat foreigners or sojourners?

Topics.Title: Non-Israelite acknowledgment of Yahweh
Topics.Question: Does a non-Israelite speak of, fear, worship, or acknowledge Yahweh in the verse?

Topics.Title: Inclusion or incorporation of a foreigner
Topics.Question: Does the verse show a non-Israelite being brought into Israel’s community, worship, or covenant privileges?
